newsitem.title: USA: Senate Leader urges Clinton to help D.C..
newsitem.headline: Senate Leader urges Clinton to help D.C..

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott Friday urged President Clinton to meet with congressional leaders on ways to help the District of Columbia solve its financial problems.
"We're sitting high and dry at the White House and Congress and there is devastation all around us. It's unacceptable," Lott, R-Miss., told reporters.
Lott was referring to Washington's high crime rate and such other problems as deteriorating schools and streets.
Many city police officers want the federal government to take over the police department, which they say is suffering from a shortage of funds.
A Washington policeman was shot and killed early Tuesday while he was sitting in his car in front of a night club.
